intro: Hawaiʻi's distinctive listening is on shortwave. Sitting in the middle of the Pacific with no VHF coverage for thousands of miles, airliners crossing to Asia and Australia report position on HF, and your VX-6 tunes low enough to hear it. Closer in, the inter-island channels between Oʻahu, Maui and Hawaiʻi Island carry constant air and sea traffic, and the volcano observatory network on the Big Island is unlike anything else in the country.
introz: 夏威夷最特别的收听内容在短波上。它位于太平洋中央，数千公里内没有 VHF 覆盖，所以飞往亚洲和澳洲的班机用短波报告位置，而 VX-6 的调谐范围足够低，能收到。近一些的话，欧胡岛、茂宜岛和大岛之间的岛际频道上空海交通不断，而大岛上的火山观测网络是全美独一无二的。

stations.z: 檀香山短波空地通信 · 海洋区
stations.d: Central East Pacific oceanic routes have no radar and no VHF, so crews pass position reports by high frequency radio to San Francisco and Honolulu Radio. Try 11.282, 8.843, 5.547, 10.057 and 13.300 MHz. Best after dark, and best away from the resort areas where the noise floor is lower. Hearing a 787 read its position from a thousand miles of open ocean is the reason to bring this radio to Hawaiʻi.
stations.dz: 中东太平洋海洋航路没有雷达也没有 VHF，机组通过短波向旧金山和檀香山无线电台报告位置。可试 11.282、8.843、5.547、10.057 和 13.300 MHz。天黑后效果最好，离开度假区、底噪更低的地方效果更好。听一架 787 从一千英里外的开阔洋面念出自己的位置，就是把这台电台带到夏威夷的理由。

stations.z: 海洋区短波 · 备用频率
stations.d: Frequency choice shifts with the time of day as propagation changes. Sweep the aeronautical HF bands rather than sitting on one.
stations.dz: 频率随时间变化而切换，因为传播条件在变。请扫整个航空短波频段，不要守着一个。

stations.d: NIST runs a second time station on Kauaʻi, transmitting on 2.5, 5, 10 and 15 MHz. It uses a female voice where Colorado's WWV uses a male one, specifically so you can tell them apart when both arrive at once. Here on the islands WWVH dominates. A small, satisfying detail.
stations.dz: 美国国家标准与技术研究院在考艾岛还有第二座授时台，发播频率为 2.5、5、10、15 MHz。它使用女声报时，而科罗拉多的 WWV 使用男声——正是为了在两者同时到达时能区分开。在岛上 WWVH 占绝对优势。一个小而令人满意的细节。

stations.d: Shares the field with Hickam and the Hawaiʻi Air National Guard, so you get civil and military traffic on the same runways. Sweep 118–128 MHz.
stations.dz: 与 Hickam 空军基地和夏威夷空中国民警卫队共用机场，所以同一条跑道上有民航也有军机。扫 118–128 MHz。

stations.d: Small fields on Molokai, Lanai and the smaller strips. Also try 122.700 and 123.000. Inter-island flying is short-hop and constant.
stations.dz: 摩洛凯岛、拉奈岛和更小的简易机场。也可试 122.700 和 123.000。岛际飞行都是短途，且班次密集。

stations.d: Tour helicopters over the Na Pali coast, Haleakalā and the volcano coordinate with each other on air-to-air frequencies. Try 123.025 and 123.075 as well.
stations.dz: 飞越 Na Pali 海岸、哈莱阿卡拉和火山的观光直升机在空空频率上互相协调。也可试 123.025 和 123.075。

stations.n: Military UHF — Pearl Harbor and Hickam
stations.z: 军用 UHF · 珍珠港与 Hickam
stations.d: A major military concentration. Set the VX-6 to AM and sweep 225–380 MHz for air operations. Listening is fine; do not transmit anywhere near a base or a naval facility.
stations.dz: 重要的军事集中区。把 VX-6 设为 AM 扫 225–380 MHz 可听空中作业。收听没问题；但绝对不要在基地或海军设施附近发射。

stations.a: Kaneohe Bay MCAS (Marion E. Carl Field) Airport (PHNG)
Kaneohe Bay MCAS (Marion E. Carl Field) Airport (PHNG)

stations.z: LNY 无塔机场公共频率
海事 16 频道 · 岛际水道
stations.d: The Molokai and Alenuihaha channels are notoriously rough, and the radio traffic reflects it. Also tugs and barges, which are how almost everything gets between the islands.
stations.dz: 摩洛凯水道和 Alenuihaha 水道以海况恶劣著称，通话内容也反映了这一点。此外还有拖轮和驳船——岛际间几乎所有货物都靠它们运送。

stations.d: The Coast Guard's Pacific search area here is larger than the continental United States.
stations.dz: 海岸警卫队在这里的太平洋搜救区面积大于美国本土。

stations.n: Marine Ch 72 — whale watch and dive
stations.z: 海事 72 频道 · 观鲸与潜水
stations.d: Humpbacks are in the Maui channels from December through April and the whale-watch fleet talks constantly.
stations.dz: 十二月到四月座头鲸都在茂宜岛水道，观鲸船队通话不断。

stations.z: 海事 06 频道 · 船间通话

stations.d: During an eruption this becomes one of the most interesting frequencies in the country: ranger closures, viewing-area management, lava-flow monitoring and USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory field teams. Scan 162–174 MHz in NFM. Kīlauea has erupted repeatedly in recent years and access changes daily.
stations.dz: 火山喷发期间，这会成为全美最有意思的频率之一：护林员封闭管理、观景区疏导、熔岩流监测，以及美国地质调查局夏威夷火山观测站的野外队伍。用 NFM 扫 162–174 MHz。基拉韦厄近年多次喷发，通行状况每天都在变。

stations.d: Summit sunrise operations and the observatory complex at 3,055 metres.
stations.dz: 山顶日出运营，以及海拔 3055 米处的观测站群。

stations.d: The marine and surf forecast segments are the useful ones, plus hurricane and tsunami information. Central Pacific hurricane season runs June to November.
stations.dz: 海事和浪况预报部分最有用，此外还有飓风和海啸信息。中太平洋飓风季从六月到十一月。

stations.d: Volcanic gas advisories appear here during eruptions, which genuinely affects where you can go.
stations.dz: 喷发期间这里会发布火山气体提示，这确实会影响你能去哪里。

stations.n: 2 m Simplex Calling — island to island
stations.d: The over-water paths between islands are excellent for VHF. From Haleakalā or the Mauna Kea access road a handheld reaches other islands easily — a path that would be impossible over land at the same distance.
stations.dz: 岛与岛之间的越水路径对 VHF 极为有利。在哈莱阿卡拉或莫纳克亚上山公路上，手台能轻松打到其他岛——同样距离在陆地上根本不可能。

stations.d: Hawaiʻi has repeaters on the high volcanoes linked across the whole island chain, partly for tsunami and hurricane emergency work. Coverage from a summit site is extraordinary. Confirm on RepeaterBook for Hawaii.
stations.dz: 夏威夷在几座高火山上架有中继台，跨整个岛链链接，部分是为海啸和飓风应急而建。山顶站点的覆盖范围极为惊人。请在 RepeaterBook 查 Hawaii 确认。

stations.n: KTUH — University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
stations.z: KTUH 夏威夷大学马诺阿分校
stations.d: Student-run and completely freeform. One of the more genuinely unpredictable stations in the country.
stations.dz: 学生自主运营、完全自由编排，是全美内容最难预测的电台之一。

stations.z: HPR-1 夏威夷公共广播新闻

stations.d: Several stations across the islands play Hawaiian-language and slack-key programming. Sweep 88–108 MHz — it is the most place-specific thing on the dial and worth finding wherever you are staying.
stations.dz: 岛上有几家电台播放夏威夷语节目和 slack-key 吉他音乐。扫 88–108 MHz——这是频段上最有地方特色的内容，值得在住处附近找一找。

stations.n: FRS and GMRS — tours and resorts
stations.z: FRS 与 GMRS · 旅游与度假区
stations.d: Tour operators, luaus, resort grounds crews and dive shops.
stations.dz: 旅游公司、luau 晚宴、度假区场务和潜水店。

stations.z: 檀香山警消 · 数字制式

stations.d: A clean ocean horizon in every direction from a coastal spot, which is close to ideal for satellite work.
stations.dz: 在海边任何方向都是干净的海平线，对接收卫星几乎是理想条件。
